title: Prologue to Abyss (3/3)
body:
We went out of the convenience store and meet Michelle.

"Michelle? Why are you here?" I said to call for her attention..

"Brianna! You deciphered my code?! Please help me!" she said as she embraces me as if she's really frightened. "Who's that guy with you, Brianna?"

"Uhmmm. I also don't know. But I think he knows something, 'cause he's the one who texted you." I clarified.

We both looked at him mystified. We're eagerly waiting for him to talk.

"You said 'HELP ME' so I'm here to help you" he said.

"But how did you know that is was her?" I said. "Wait, please explain to me first how did you crack the code?"

"Simple. A is for 1, B is for 2, C is for 3, D is for 4 and so forth. Then just convert it to roman numerals. Dots are for separating the roman numerals, two dots are for separating words that Michelle wants to convey" he said

"Yes, you're correct. But what I'm eager to know is how were you able to know that it was me who wrote that on the board. I wrote that without hoping that someone could understand what I wrote, yet alone, someone could know that I was the one who wrote it" Michelle said.

"Wait" I said, as I looked the photo again. "So Michelle wrote VIII.V.XII.XVI..XIII.V. and based on the explanation of the homeless guy, translating it would come up to... HELP ME!!!" I shouted.

"You took so long, B.S." he said.

"Stop calling me that." I said. "But why you ask for help, Michelle? You even went on the trouble of making this code."

"I can't tell you now." Michelle quietly said. "I really want to know how was he able to tell that it was me" she said perplexedly.

"Child's play" he said. "Thanks to B.S.'s phone, I was able to know."

"What? You haven't explained a damn thing! Is it GPS? There's no way you could use GPS like that... I'm out of ideas." i said irritatingly.

"Through the photos on your phone" he said.

"Yeah, of course it's though my phone. I took a photo of Michelle's code using my phone! Please cut the chase, explain how were you able to determine that it was Michelle all along using just pictures" i said.

"Since you treated me ice cream, I'll explain everything to you very carefully. First, the writing on the blackboard tells everything about her height. Notice that the one who wrote the code wrote it as big as she could. Am I right?"

"Yes" Michelle confirmed.

"Now observe that she was not able to cover the whole blackboard, perhaps she can't reach it. So based on the photo, I can deduce that the one who wrote the code is a girl. The average height for girl's in the Philippines is 4 feet and 11 inches whereas boys' is at 5 feet and 4 inches. Based on B.S.'s height, the one who wrote the code must be shorter than B.S. since B.S. must have took the photo at chin height" he said.

"But that's not conclusive!" Michelle said.

"Yes, of course it is not conclusive. But I can minimize my scope of search greatly. It is highly probable that the one who wrote the code is a girl and a classmate of B.S."

"So that's why you scan through my gallery!" i shouted.

"Yes, but that's not all. I've looked for a girl shorter than you, and considering how desperate the one who wrote the code was, to the point of creating code, she must be suffering from something. And there I was, looking at your photos and noticed that Michelle fits perfectly. B.S. look at the photo I showed you a while ago, the one with you and Michelle."

"Wait...There it it" I said.

"Now, can you describe Michelle using the photo" he commanded.

"She's beautiful, and as you said, she's shorter than me." I said, and as I inspect it further I noticed something. "Wait, was your eyes really like that, Michelle? Your eye bags are visible, and you looked a lot skinnier when I first saw you. Are you eating well? Are you depressed or something?" I insensitively said.

 Michelle sat at the bench and looked down.

"Out of all the photos, only Michelle fits perfectly to my deductions. She must have been very desperate for help. And one thing strikes me as odd - the photo was dated last week, so it's fairly recent. Considering how hot the weather right now, Michelle's wearing a jacket in the picture" he said.

I looked at the photo to confirm what the guy said, then turned my eyes to Michelle...She's also wearing a jacket right now!

"What the? I didn't notice it! Why are you wearing a jacket, Michelle? It's super hot right now. Tell me what's wrong."

Michelle is silent. She's ignoring my queries. Frightened by something I don't know.

"Hey, what's your name? My friend, our professor, all of us were not able to decipher the code, but you, you did not just deciphered the code, you also determined who's the one who wrote it. Are you a detective or what?" I inquired.

"Don't use your eyes for thinking. The brain is the proper faculty for thinking, not the eyes" he said. "Now, let's get to the main reason why I texted you Michelle. Tell me why do you need help."

Michelle is still silent. While waiting for Michelle to speak up, I used the moment to translate what the guy texted, when translated, it said "OK MEET ME AT THE PARK".

Michelle opened the zipper on her jacket and slowly showed us her shoulder and arms. She was full of bruises.

"Who did that to you, Michelle? Was it your parents? Or someone's bullying you? Is it our classmate?" I angrily said.

"Stupid. Won't you try to relax for a bit?" the man said. "First, all of the students of Ecclesiastes University are required to live in dorms, so it's unlikely that her parents did that. Second, if someone's bullying her, writing a code doesn't make sense. She could have just reported it to the dean or someone... I bet, it was far more worse than just bullying."

"Wait, how did you know that we're studying at EU?" I asked.

"What a stupid question. You're wearing EU uniform at the picture. Plus, EU is the only college university around here" he said.

And even after all our talking, Michelle is still tight-lipped.

"Abyss Syndicate..." the guy said.

Suddenly, Michelle turned pale, her reaction is inexplicable - a combination of fright and weakness and guilt.

Michelle looked at the man intensely and said "Where did you hear that?!"

"Just tell me everything, I'm here to eradicate that abominable group!" he confidently said.

I'm still confused, what's with the Abyss Syndicate? I feel that this conversation is a really dangerous one. Now, I'm really eager to know the identity of this guy in front of us.

"LSD" Michelle finally spoke.

"Lysergic acid diethylamide. Why are you saying that, Michelle?" I asked.

"The school is rough, you need to maintain good grades. I want to excel, I want to maintain my grades so I won't be kicked out from EU. But it was way too hard for me. Then one day, someone gave me LSD. At first, I don't want to take it, but as hope turns dim, something in my brain told me that LSD would help me. Yes, I feel relaxed, my head is floating, suddenly I can focus more, study better every time I take LSD. But, it is also the gateway to hell, I didn't even notice that I'm way too deep in this misery. I'm way too dependent to that drug. In search for more of it, little did I know that I was already in the palms of this Abyss Syndicate. They started extracting money out of me in exchange of LSD. And when I was unable to comply, they started beating me. Abyss Syndicate is not just an ordinary group that someone could mess with. It is truly an abyss of darkness. I'm so desperate to get out of it, but I know that demise would only wait for me." she cried.

"I'm affiliated with a cop, he might be able to help you. But, I think it's best for you to hide as soon as possible. Your code was way too easy. Abyss Syndicate might be on you now." he said.

"Ok. I'll trust you. Please destroy that syndicate, Sir ---?" Michelle said.

"Beta. They call me Beta. And you don't have to tell me, I'll definitely stop them" he said.

This day is a peculiar one. I've met a man named Beta. You can't even consider it a name. The second letter of the Greek alphabet. He's mysterious, but from being a homeless, my impression of him suddenly turned 180 degrees. He's a guy worth knowing.

I think I'm in love...not with him. I'm in love with his brain.
